text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing errors before they hit users and lets us validate fixes without risk. The trade-off is delayed feedback for the PR author, but we gain confidence in the system’s accuracy before trusting it with merged PRs.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks slowing reviews by adding noise to every PR, not just routing errors. A better alternative is to run PR-Agent in shadow mode on a random 10% of merged PRs first—this tests accuracy without delaying reviews or confusing authors. Settle it by measuring review time impact and false-positive rate in shadow mode before expanding.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first, not open—this catches routing errors after they’re proven safe by human review, reducing noise in active PRs. Then expand to 10% of merged PRs to validate accuracy without slowing down open reviews.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. This catches routing errors in real merged code without slowing open reviews or confusing authors. The trade-off is delayed detection—errors sit in merged PRs briefly—but we avoid review noise and validate fixes on proven-safe changes first.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first, then expand to 10% of merged PRs after validating accuracy.

Result: PR-Agent catches routing errors in real merged code without slowing open reviews or confusing authors. Owned by Overhaul.
